报告元数据.主营业务: 太阳能光伏电池及半导体专用设备的研发、制造与销售
报告元数据.企业名称: 深圳市捷佳伟创新能源装备股份有限公司
报告元数据.报告页码/章节: 第3页 About This Report；第10页 Key Performance

环保投资.原文: Total Investment in Environmental Protection RMB (10K) / 2,311.80（第44页 Key Performance Form）

环境管理体系.值: 公司建立《环境、职业健康安全管理手册》等制度，构建由总经理领导、质量管理部协调、其他部门支持的管理架构；供应商评价中考察ISO 14001认证情况
环境管理体系.原文: It has established systems such as the Environmental, Occupational Health and Safety Management Manual, and built a management structure led by the General Manager, coordinated by the Quality Management Department, and supported by other departments.（第20页 Environmental Management System）；the Company investigates whether suppliers hold certifications such as ISO 14001 (Environmental Management System)（第29页 Supply Chain ESG Management）

碳管理体系建设.值: 公司开展温室气体核算、碳足迹分析、减排策略制定、碳中和目标设定、碳交易及碳税应对等专项培训；依据GHG Protocol及《温室气体排放核算与报告要求 第29部分：机械设备制造企业》进行温室气体统计
碳管理体系建设.原文: the Company has conducted specialized training covering core topics such as greenhouse gas accounting, carbon footprint analysis, formulation of emission reduction strategies, setting carbon neutrality targets, carbon trading and response to carbon taxation, etc.（第19页 Response to Climate Change）；The company's greenhouse gas statistics are based on the Greenhouse Gas Protocol: A Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (2004) and Requirements of the Greenhouse Gas Emissions Accounting and Reporting—Part 29: Mechanical Equipment Manufacturing Enterprises（第20页 Metrics and Targets）

碳总量.原文: Total GHG Emissions 20,762.20 tCO2e（第10页 Key Performance；第20页 Metrics and Targets；第44页 Key Performance Form）

碳排放强度.原文: GHG Emission Intensity 1.34 tCO2e per million RMB of revenue（第10页 Key Performance；第20页 Metrics and Targets）

碳排放抵消与同比变化.原文: Total GHG Emissions tCO2e 24,401.86 20,762.20（第44页 Key Performance Form）；PV Generation Amount 808.01*10⁴ kWh，Amount of GHG Emission Reduction 4,287.30 tCO2e（第10页 Key Performance）

能源类型和强度.原文: The Company's energy consumption consists primarily of electricity.；Total energy consumption 4,921.99 tce；Energy consumption intensity 0.32 tce/million RMB in revenue（第22页 Energy Metrics and Targets）

能耗同比变化.原文: Total Energy Consumption tce 5,755.65 4,921.99（第44页 Key Performance Form）

节能目标与改造情况.值: 制定《能源管理程序》，通过建设光伏系统推进可再生能源替代；照明全部更换为LED节能灯，部分地下车库升级为LED感应灯；安装37个新能源汽车充电桩，已配备11辆新能源商务车；2025年光伏发电808.01万kWh，可再生能源消费占比16.79%
节能目标与改造情况.原文: the Company has formulated the Energy Management Procedures. At the same time, the Company actively promotes the substitution of renewable energy by establishing photovoltaic systems；All lighting has been replaced with LED energy-saving lamps；constructing 37 charging stations for new energy vehicles；the Company has equipped 11 new energy commercial vehicles；PV generation 808.01 10,000 kWh；Proportion of renewable energy consumption 16.79%（第22页 Efficient Resource Utilization）

供应商碳培训及考核情况.值: 报告期内开展供应商培训12场，共20家供应商参与
供应商碳培训及考核情况.原文: During the reporting period, the Company conducted 12 supplier training sessions, with a total of 20 suppliers participating.（第28页 Deepening Responsible Procurement）

供应商碳披露及评价要求.值: 公司制定《供应商管理程序》《新供应商开发与管理指引》《采购部门管理制度》等，明确供应商准入与评价流程；在供应商准入和定期评审阶段，对供应商是否建立ISO 9001质量管理体系进行评分；考察供应商是否持有ISO 14001、ISO 45001、QC080000等认证
供应商碳披露及评价要求.原文: the Company has formulated a series of regulations, including the Supplier Management Procedure, New Supplier Development and Management Guidelines, and Procurement Department Management System, clarifying the the supplier onboarding and evaluation process.；the Company investigates whether suppliers hold certifications such as ISO 14001 (Environmental Management System), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health and Safety Management System), and QC080000 (Hazardous Substance Process Management System), which serve as important references for supplier evaluation.（第28-29页 Deepening Responsible Procurement）

供应商绿色采购标准.值: 公司制定《环境保护与安全承诺》，明确要求供应商在运营中严格遵守环境、职业健康安全法律法规及公司管理要求；与供应商签署《质量与保密协议》《采购框架协议》，明确交付材料标准
供应商绿色采购标准.原文: The Company has formulated the Environmental Protection and Safety Commitment, clearly requiring suppliers to strictly comply with environmental, occupational health, and safety laws, regulations, and company management requirements during operations.；By signing the Quality and Confidentiality Agreement and the Procurement Framework Agreement with suppliers, the Company defines the standards for materials delivered by suppliers.（第29页 Supply Chain ESG Management）

供应商激励.值: 根据供应商评级结果实施分级管理：A级优秀供应商在付款、订单、检验和物料采购方面享有优先权
供应商激励.原文: Grade A: Excellent suppliers will receive priority in payment, orders, inspection, and material procurement（第29页 Supplier Categorization）

循环经济链塑造.值: 公司推行绿色办公，实施节水、节电、办公用品回收、垃圾分类等措施；设备清洗采用逆流漂洗方式，清洗废水回用于厂房空调冷却塔
循环经济链塑造.原文: Counterflow rinsing methods are used in equipment cleaning, and wastewater from cleaning is reused in the plant's air conditioning cooling towers.（第22页 Water Saving）；Comprehensively implement waste sorting.（第22页 Waste Sorting and Cleanliness Management）

绿色物流.值: 公司通过制度引导与配套设施相结合推进运输低碳转型：制定绿色出行费用标准，园区内建设37个新能源汽车充电桩，逐步以新能源车辆替换传统商务车，目前已配备11辆新能源商务车
绿色物流.原文: Formulating expense standards related to green travel to guide employees toward low-carbon travel methods; constructing 37 charging stations for new energy vehicles within the park to support employees' low-carbon commuting; and gradually promoting the transition to green business vehicles by continuously replacing conventional vehicles with new energy vehicles for business travel. As of now, the Company has equipped 11 new energy commercial vehicles（第22页 Green Travel）
